blocks.title: Units
blocks.md: Short lengths: **centimetres** (cm). Longer: **metres** (m). Roads: **kilometres** (km). 1 m = 100 cm. 1 km = 1 000 m.

blocks.caption: A line of 8 cm.
blocks.alt: A ruler from 0 to 10 with an orange bar of length 8.

blocks.title: Changing
blocks.md: m to cm: times 100. cm to m: divide by 100. km to m: times 1 000. 3 m = 300 cm. 2 km = 2 000 m.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Use the same unit before adding.
- 150 cm is 1 m 50 cm.
- A km is much longer than a m.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: Douala to Edéa is about 60 km. Change 2 km to m.

blocks.title: Mass
blocks.md: **Mass** tells how heavy something is. Units: **grams** (g) and **kilograms** (kg). 1 kg = 1 000 g. A bag of rice can be 25 kg. A small pencil is a few grams.

blocks.title: Capacity
blocks.md: **Capacity** tells how much a container holds. Units: **litres** (l) and **millilitres** (ml). 1 l = 1 000 ml. A big bottle holds 1 or 2 litres.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Do not mix mass and capacity.
- 1 kg is 1 000 g, not 100 g.
- Use the same unit before adding.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: A bag has 2 kg of beans. How many grams?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: A jug holds 3 litres. How many ml?

blocks.title: Perimeter
blocks.md: The **perimeter** is the distance all the way round a shape. Add the lengths of all its sides.

blocks.caption: Rectangle: 5 cm by 3 cm.
blocks.alt: A rectangle labelled 5 cm on top and 3 cm on the side.

blocks.title: Rectangle and square
blocks.md: Rectangle: add the four sides. Two lengths and two widths: P = 2 × length + 2 × width. Square: 4 × side.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- A rectangle has four sides to add, not two.
- Use the same unit for all sides.
- Perimeter is a length (cm), not an area.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: A rectangle is 5 cm long and 3 cm wide. Find its perimeter.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: A square field has sides of 20 m. What is its perimeter?

blocks.title: Units of time
blocks.md: 60 seconds = 1 minute. 60 minutes = 1 hour. 24 hours = 1 day. 7 days = 1 week. 12 months = 1 year. The a.m. is from midnight to noon. The p.m. is from noon to midnight.

blocks.caption: 10:10 on the clock.
blocks.alt: A clock face with the short hand just after 10 and the long hand on 2.

blocks.title: How long?
blocks.md: To find how long: count on from the start time to the end time. From 8:15 to 9:45: 45 minutes to 9:00, then 45 more. Total 1 hour 30 minutes.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- An hour has 60 minutes, not 100.
- 1 hour 30 minutes is 90 minutes.
- Check a.m. and p.m.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: School starts at 7:30 a.m. and ends at 1:30 p.m. How many hours?
steps: From 12:30 to 1:30 is 1 more hour. Total 6 hours.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: A film lasts 90 minutes. How many hours and minutes?

objectives: Work out a shopping bill and change.
reviewNotes: Syllabus references, scope and level of difficulty are to be checked against the official text; all facts, formulas and worked examples to be verified by a teacher before release.

blocks.title: Money
blocks.md: In Cameroon we use **FCFA**. A **bill** shows what each item costs and the **total**. **Change** = money paid − total cost.

blocks.caption: A small shopping bill.
blocks.alt: A table with items, prices, quantities and cost.

blocks.title: Steps
blocks.md: 1. Multiply the price by the quantity. 2. Add all costs. 3. Subtract from the money paid to find the change.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Do not forget to multiply by how many.
- Write FCFA in the answer.
- Check that the change is less than what was paid.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: Bih buys rice for 1 200 FCFA and oil for 800 FCFA. She pays 2 500 FCFA. Change?
